verdict.rationale: dlt ships a dbt runner that runs dbt from inside a dlt pipeline (it can create a dbt virtual environment on the fly) and advertises end-to-end dlt→dbt pipelines, so transformations can run in the same Python flow straight after the load. dltHub orchestration adds chaining and lineage-aware pipeline runs, and the dbt generator scaffolds staging and fact models from the loaded schema. missing for 10: explicit docs showing dbt is triggered on load completion (e.g. only when new data arrives), detail on passing load state or incremental context to dbt, independent or hands-on corroboration.
